resources.name: Autism Society Habilitation Organization (ASHO)
resources.mission: We are dedicated to helping individuals with Intellectual or Developmental Disabilities (IDD) and those with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) along with their their families in the South Asian/Bangladeshi-American community with programs of care, support services, technical know-how, and resources for improving their quality of life. We are focused on awareness-building to eliminate stigma about IDD and ASD through a flow of information and knowledge. We believe that individuals with IDD and ASD have the right to integrate into society, and to have age-appropriate support of their choice.

resources.name: Legal Services NYC/Queens
resources.mission: Queens Legal Services, a program of Legal Services NYC, is a civil legal services organization with a mission to fight poverty and seek racial, social, and economic justice on behalf of low-income New Yorkers. We are a part of Legal Services NYC, which has offices in each borough. We provide a wide range of civil legal services and balance individual case representation, impact litigation and policy advocacy, community outreach, education, and training. We do landlord/tenant; disability (Social Security Disability/SSI/ Retirement Benefits); Medicaid and Medicare Issues; SNAP; Public Benefits; Unemployment & Wage Issues; Discrimination based on protected class; Family Court cases; Domestic Violence; Foreclosure; Consumer Issues; Tax issues; Veterans cases; and LGBTQ+/HIV Advocacy issues. We are glad to do Know-Your-Rights presentations for your organization and your clients on any legal issues we cover.
resources.languages: All languages - we utilize Language Line as well as having in-house interpreters in Spanish; Mandarin; Bengali; and Arabic.

resources.mission: The three-part mission of TMNK is to use integrity and excellence to equip this generation with the tools needed to instill self-esteem through the Performing Arts to develop the talents and gifts that are resident within every child. Public speaking is one of the greatest human fears, and TMNK builds youth's confidence with services and life skills that require their entire person. The Me Nobody Knows offers performing arts and mentoring workshops for students of all ages, along with self-care seminars for senior citizens.

resources.name: Tyler Nicole Foundation
resources.mission: The Tyler Nicole Foundation provides perinatal loss counseling and support for families affected by perinatal loss, high-risk pregnancies, and childhood illnesses, grounded in a commitment to reproductive justice and perinatal health equity. We work to ease grief and connect families to vital resources while advocating for equitable access to prenatal care and specialized services. Through public awareness and research promotion, we address systemic disparities to improve outcomes for all families facing these challenges.
resources.fees: Most of the services are offered free of charge.
